title: Tilted disc row, one flip every three seconds
summary: Six thick translucent red discs stand in a diagonal row on black under a red glow; every 3 s one disc, out of order, spins through edge-on to broad face and re-seats. A calm, loopable object loop with no copy.
use_when: A loopable dark background or interstitial between scenes of a longer film
A brand whose mark is a coin, token, chip or disc shape
A silent autoplay tile that needs slow, regular life without text
A hold under an end card or a lower-third where motion must stay calm

sfx.event: a disc turns edge-on and swings to its broad face
the flipped disc re-seats in the row

structure.shot: six tilted translucent red discs on a diagonal, low-left to upper-right, red glow behind; disc 4 (from left) flips
structure.camera: static (locked-off: resting discs keep position and size in every cell)
structure.motion: hold 0.00-0.77; disc 4 tilts at 0.77, edge-on 1.00-1.27, broad face lying near-horizontal and brightest 1.50-2.00, re-seated by 2.27; flip ~45 fr (+-0.25 s), ease suggested easings.inOutSine (not measurable); rim highlight brightens at broad face
disc 6 tilts at 3.77-4.00, edge-on 4.27, broad face 4.50-5.00 (partly off the right edge), re-seated by 5.50; same ~45 fr flip (+-0.25 s), start 90 fr after flip 1
disc 2 tilts at 6.50-6.77, edge-on 7.00, broad face 7.50-7.77, re-seated 8.00-8.27; ~45 fr flip (+-0.25 s), 90 fr after flip 2
disc 3 tilts at 9.77, edge-on 10.00, broad face 10.50-10.77, re-seated 11.00-11.27; ~45 fr flip (+-0.25 s), 90 fr after flip 3

structure.shot: same row; disc 1 (lower-left end, partly off frame) flips
structure.motion: disc 1 tilts at 12.77, edge-on 13.00, broad face 13.50-13.77 (crosses the left edge), re-seated by 14.00; ~45 fr flip (+-0.25 s), 90 fr after flip 4

structure.shot: same row; disc 5 (second from right) flips, then the row rests as at frame 0
structure.motion: disc 5 edge-on 15.77-16.00, broad face turned to camera (near-round) 16.27-16.77, returning 17.00, re-seated 17.27; ~45 fr flip (+-0.25 s), 90 fr after flip 5; last cell matches the first (loop point)

params.discColor: disc body colour (brand accent, reference uses a deep red)
params.discCount: visible discs in the row, 6 in the reference plus one cut off at the left edge
params.flipOrder: order of discs to flip, reference 4, 6, 2, 3, 1, 5 (counted from lower-left)
params.interval: frames between flip starts, 90 fr at 30 fps

notes: One shot, no cuts (cuts.json empty); every transition_out is continuous, last is end. Silent reference: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Flip cadence measured from sheet timestamps at 0.25 s resolution: starts ~0.77, 3.77, 6.50/6.77, 9.77, 12.77, 15.50/15.77 = 90 fr period; flip length ~45 fr (+-0.25 s). Easing, axis and whether the turn is 180 or 360 degrees are not measurable from 4 fps sheets (a symmetric disc reads the same). motion.json labels flip seconds camera-zoom (0.7-1.3 %/s) because the flipping disc changes the picture; resting discs do not move, so the camera is treated as locked-off. Difficulty hard because the discs are 3D objects with thickness and perspective; render_cost light if rebuilt with CSS 3D transforms, heavy if rebuilt in R3F. Proposed term (not in vocabulary): disc-flip-cascade.
